description: Ask the owner to run a failed or blocked task of your Goal again. The owner runs the same fences as an automatic requeue and does not run the task itself. Under every-step confirmation the call returns a rework-request card instead of performing the rework, and the person's approval applies it as an agent; a committed automatic request counts in the shared cap. Parameters name the task, the Run whose result the rework follows, and the reason.

parameters.taskRef.goalId: The task's goal id; it must be your Goal.
parameters.afterRunRef: The Run whose failure or result precedes this rework.
parameters.reason: Why the task should run again; the owner's reason text.
parameters.acknowledgement: The Session message this answers; omit unless the request answers one.
parameters.basisMessage: A question your line can read that another line formally answered, as the new basis; judge yourself whether the answer gives one, else omit. A Session message only, not an artifact.
parameters.expected: Exact W1 pins; omit rather than guess a fresh revision. Read the Goal revision from its Goal card and the Run revision from its Run card (the Task card's executions lists the Run refs); the optional TaskReworkRefusal pin is the current requeue refusal.
parameters.expected[].revision: The exact version the caller saw; a mismatch is rejected with the current record.
